name: advanced commerce 01 next catalog
task: Build the domain and server-rendering slice of a Next.js-style product catalog. Inspect the harness, create lib/catalog.js exporting listFeaturedProducts(products) and app/products/page.js exporting renderProductCards(products). listFeaturedProducts must keep only featured products with stock greater than zero, sort by price ascending without mutating the input, and renderProductCards must return accessible product-card HTML containing name, formatted USD price, and data-product-id. Run the declared unit tests with validate_project, inspect the final diff with git_operation, and report only verified results.
constraints: Create only lib/catalog.js and app/products/page.js; harness files are immutable.
Use dependency-free ESM so this offline health campaign is deterministic.
Do not claim a full Next.js runtime was installed; this scenario verifies framework-facing domain and rendering contracts.
Use validate_project for tests and git_operation for final diff review.
workspaceInstructions: This is stage 1 of an accumulated commerce workspace. Preserve these implementation files in later stages.
